oracles.name: test_http_adapter_timeout_handling
oracles.observation: HTTP client intercepts socket/request timeout and raises ProviderTimeoutError.

oracles.name: test_http_adapter_429_exponential_backoff_and_retry
oracles.observation: HTTP client handles HTTP 429 with exponential backoff and retry, returning AIResponse when successful and raising ProviderRateLimitExceededError when retries are exhausted.

oracles.name: test_http_adapter_route_provenance_stamping
oracles.observation: Outbound HTTP request stamps provenance headers (X-Route-Provenance, X-Config-Revision-ID) and rejects missing revision with MissingConfigProvenanceError fail-closed; endpoints are strictly bounded by ApprovedEndpointRegistry.
